name: module_coverage
description: Aggregates verification coverage for a single module. Returns one row of rollup statistics — total requirements in the module, how many have at least one VERIFIED_BY edge, how many have none, and the resulting coverage percentage — so an engineer or auditor can see at a glance how close the module is to full verification. Also counts how many of the uncovered requirements are classified as safety-critical, which is the figure that matters most for a DO-178C audit.
when_to_use: Fire this template when the user asks for coverage stats about one specific module. Typical phrasings: 'how many requirements in FCC have verifications', 'what is the coverage of the PWR module', 'verification coverage for module INS', 'module coverage on CDL'. The user must name a module. For per-requirement gap lists (not just counts), pair with orphan_requirements.

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: The Module.name whose verification coverage we want. Example values: 'FCC', 'PWR', 'INS', 'CDL', 'COMM', 'NAV'. Use the exact uppercase module code as it appears in the DOORS export.

cypher:
MATCH (m:Module {name: $module})-[:CONTAINS]->(r:Requirement)
WITH m, collect(r) AS reqs
UNWIND reqs AS r
OPTIONAL MATCH (r)-[:VERIFIED_BY]->(t:TestProcedure)
WITH m, r, count(DISTINCT t) AS test_count
WITH m,
     count(r)                                                    AS total_requirements,
     sum(CASE WHEN test_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)             AS verified_requirements,
     sum(CASE WHEN test_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)             AS uncovered_requirements,
     sum(CASE WHEN test_count = 0
                AND r.safety_classification IN ['A','B','DAL-A','DAL-B']
              THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                                 AS uncovered_safety_critical
RETURN m.name                                                    AS module,
       total_requirements,
       verified_requirements,
       uncovered_requirements,
       uncovered_safety_critical,
       CASE WHEN total_requirements = 0 THEN 0.0
            ELSE round(100.0 * verified_requirements / total_requirements, 1)
       END                                                       AS coverage_percent
notes: Returns exactly one row per invocation — a rollup over the whole module — so the limit is set to 1. Safety-critical uncovered count accepts both DAL-style values ('A'/'B') and prefixed forms ('DAL-A'/'DAL-B') because the corpus has historically stored both. Module names are case-sensitive on :Module.name; agents should preserve the user's capitalisation and only fall back to a case-insensitive match via Text2Cypher if this template returns zero rows.
